### 1.1- plot_all cells with anno

```{r}
p1<-CellDimPlot(selected_obj, 
            palcolor = mycolor , # customize the cell color
            label = TRUE, # Add number
            label_insitu = TRUE, # add cell type name
            pt.size = 0.7, # define the point size
            group.by = "cell_type_0.7", 
            reduction = "UMAP",
            theme_use = "theme_blank")

ggsave(p1,filename = "R9_1.1_all_cells_umap.pdf",width = 12, height =6)
```

### 1.2- split plot for study

```{r}
# define the color

# reorder the study
levels(selected_obj@meta.data$study)

		# Reorder the factor levels based on your desired order
selected_obj@meta.data$study <- factor(selected_obj@meta.data$study, 
                                       levels = c("FsEpi", 
                                                  "FibHSE", 
                                                  "PmtHEE"))


p1<-CellDimPlot(selected_obj, 
            palcolor = mycolor, # customize the cell color
            pt.size = 0.7, # define the point size
            group.by = "cell_type_0.7", 
            split.by = "study",
            reduction = "UMAP",
            cells.highlight = TRUE,
            theme_use = "theme_blank",
            legend.position = "right",
            nrow = 1,
            ncol = 3) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 20))

ggsave(p1,filename = "R9_1.2_Cell_type_umap_plot_split.pdf",
       width = 15, height =5)
```

## 4- New UMAP plot for all cells for 1

### 4.1 Clean again the cells

```{r}
load("R3_4.1_cleaned_seurat_0.7_ct_integrated.Rdata")
cleaned_0.7_ct-> selected_obj
```

```{r}
## remove the cells in basal near cluster Fib
library(shiny)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
```

```{r}
## remove unwanted clusrters
integrated_snn_res.0.7 <- unique(selected_obj$integrated_snn_res.0.7) # check clusters

interested_cluster <- integrated_snn_res.0.7[!(integrated_snn_res.0.7 %in% c("13", "15"))]

new_seurat <- subset(selected_obj, 
                      integrated_snn_res.0.7 %in% interested_cluster)

# recheck the cluster numner
unique(new_seurat$integrated_snn_res.0.7)
```

```{r}
##> further remove noisy cells

##> devtools::install_github('vikkki/xSelectCells@main')
barcodes <- xSelectCells::xSelectCells(new_seurat)
  ## after selection , we have the local vector
barcodes-> Cell_id_remove_1 # 
barcodes-> Cell_id_remove_2 #
barcodes-> Cell_id_remove_3
barcodes-> Cell_id_remove_4

remove_id<- unique(c(Cell_id_remove_1,Cell_id_remove_2,Cell_id_remove_3,Cell_id_remove_4))


##> remove unwanted cells from obj
setdiff(colnames(new_seurat),remove_id)-> rest_cell_bc ## 22775 cells

cleaned_seurat_0.7 <- subset(new_seurat, 
                                cells= rest_cell_bc)

# check the cell types
table(cleaned_seurat_0.7$cell_type_0.7)
  ## BAS-I  BAS-II BAS-III  BAS-IV   BAS-V    Endo     Fib   GRN-I  GRN-II GRN-III      LC   MC/TD     MEL 
  ## 902     563    1651    2446    2415     114     451    1168    2220    1185     111      75     987 
  ## SPN-I  SPN-II SPN-III  SPN-IV 
   ## 3026     653    1829    2979 
```

### 4.2 rename the HF_stem cells

```{r}
library(dplyr) 
## "value 1" will be replaced by "value 2"
## "value 1" ~ "Pericyte",
cleaned_seurat_0.7@meta.data <- cleaned_seurat_0.7@meta.data %>%
  mutate(cell_type_0.7 = case_when(
cell_type_0.7 == "MC/TD" ~ "HF",  
    TRUE ~ cell_type_0.7
  ))

# Check again
table(cleaned_seurat_0.7$cell_type_0.7)
```

## 5- New VlnPlot for all cells for 1

```{r}
save(cleaned_seurat_0.7, file = "R9_4.2_new_cleaned_seurat_0.7.Rdata") # new cleaned seurat obj

cleaned_seurat_0.7 -> selected_inte
  
#>> SET rna assay
DefaultAssay(selected_inte) <- "RNA"

Idents(selected_inte) <- 'cell_type_0.7'

plot_genes <- c(
  "CCNB1", #BAS-I
  "MKI67", # BAS-I, BAS-II
  "PCNA", # BAS-II, BAS-III
  "KRT15", # BAS-IV
  "KRT5","KRT14", # BAS-V
  
  "KRT1","KRT10", # SPN-I/II/III/IV
  "SPINK5", # GRN-I/II
  "FLG", # GRN-III
  "DCN", # Fib
  "PMEL", # MEL
  "KRT17", # HF
  "CD207", # Langerhans
  "PECAM1") # ENDO


## personalize the x-axis oeder
selected_inte$cell_type_0.7 <- factor(x = selected_inte$cell_type_0.7, levels = c(
"BAS-I",
"BAS-II",
"BAS-III",
"BAS-IV",
"BAS-V",
"SPN-I",
"SPN-II",
"SPN-III",
"SPN-IV" ,
"GRN-I",
"GRN-II",
"GRN-III",
"Fib",
"MEL",
"HF",
"LC",
"Endo"))

p1 <- VlnPlot(selected_inte, 
              features= plot_genes,
              group.by="cell_type_0.7",
              stack = T, 
              sort = F, 
              flip = T, 
              fill.by = "ident",
              cols= mycolor) +  # the order of color very important for legend, legend follows only the color order without name.
theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 10)) + 
theme(text = element_text(size = 10))+ 
theme(legend.position = "right")+ xlab("")+
stat_summary(fun.y = median, geom='point',size= 5, colour = "black", shape = 95)

ggsave("R9_5_marker_genens_new_vlnplot.pdf", plot = p1, width = 6 , height = 5)
```

## 6- New_KC_state only plot using previous R4

```{r}
## input
## input is seurat
load("R4_6.3_KC_only_processed.Rdata")
KC_only_processed-> selected_kc
```

### 6.1 Add new KC State annotation

```{r}
table(selected_kc$cell_type_0.7)
#> get the cluster number "as character"
cluster_number = names(table(selected_kc$cell_type_0.7))
cluster_number = cluster_number[1:12]

  #> make corresponding cluster annotation.
annotation_cluster = c(
"BAS",
"BAS",
"BAS",
"BAS",
"BAS",
"SPN",
"SPN",
"SPN",
"SPN",
"GRN",
"GRN",
"GRN")

# make the corresponding annotation table with cell_cluster
cluster_anno = data.frame(cluster_number, annotation_cluster, stringsAsFactors = F)

# add empty column for meta.data
selected_kc@meta.data$KC_states = "NA"

# fill the cell types by cluster number comparison
for(i in 1:nrow(cluster_anno)) { 
selected_kc@meta.data[which(selected_kc@meta.data$cell_type_0.7 == cluster_anno$cluster_number[i]),'KC_states'] <- cluster_anno$annotation_cluster[i] 
  }

# check the result and performance
table(selected_kc$KC_states)
  # BAS  GRN  SPN 
  # 8002 4615 8488 

table(selected_kc$cell_type_0.7)
  # BAS-I  BAS-II BAS-III  BAS-IV   BAS-V   SPN-I  SPN-II SPN-III  SPN-IV   GRN-I  GRN-II GRN-III 
  #  902     563    1652    2446    2439    3026     653    1830    2979    1168    2220    1227 
```

### 6.2- New barplot for KC state ratio

```{r}
### barplot
library(Seurat)
library(scRNAtoolVis)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(Seurat)
library(scCustomize)

library(scales)
library(ggsci)

mycolor= c(
"BAS" = "#759B59",
"SPN"="#E3AF6A",
"GRN"="#D595A7")


selected_kc$KC_states <- factor(x = selected_kc$KC_states, 
                                levels = c(
"BAS",
"SPN",
"GRN"))

p1<-cellRatioPlot(object = selected_kc,
              sample.name = "study", # x-axis data
              celltype.name = "KC_states", # filled value
              col.width	= 0.7, #column width, default 0.7.
              fill.col = mycolor,
              flow.alpha = 0.25, # flow color alpha, default 0.25.
              flow.curve = 0.5)+
  theme(axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(angle = 45,
                                          hjust = 1,
                                          size = 10,
                                          color = "black"))

ggsave("R9_6.2_barplot_KC_and_Study.pdf", plot = p1, 
       width = 5, height = 5)
```
